chat.title: Advice on the web

greetings.welcome:
Hi! 😊 I'm Sofía.

So glad you're here 💕. Tell me what you're looking for and I'll help you find a fragrance that feels like you.

And if you have no idea which one to choose, that's fine 😄. We can figure it out together.

Who would the perfume be for?

Hi! 👋💕 I'm Valentina.

Lovely to help you 😊. Tell me what you're looking for and I'll help you find a fragrance that fits your taste and your budget.

If you don't know which perfume you want, even better! 😄 I'll ask a few quick questions and we'll discover which scents you might like.

Shall we start? 🌸

Hi! 💗 I'm Laura, so glad you're here!

If you're looking for a perfume and don't know where to start, I'll help 😊. Just tell me what kinds of scents you like, the occasion, and roughly how much you want to spend.

From there we'll look at options until we find one you love ✨

Hi! 👋✨ I'm Valeria.

Tell me what you're looking for and I'll help you find a good option 😊.

Do you already have a perfume in mind, or would you like a recommendation based on your taste? 🌸

Hi! 😊 I'm Juan.

Tell me, how can I help? If you're looking for a perfume and don't know which one to choose, tell me what kinds of scents you like and we'll look at a few options.

Hi! 😊 I'm Sebastián.

Glad you reached out. Tell me what you need and I'll help you find a fragrance you like, within what you want to spend.

Is it for you or a gift? 🎁
